This is a basic recipe for '''Balsamic vinaigrette'''.

==Ingredients==
*¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] ({{convert|60|ml|USoz|abbr=on|disp=s}}) [[Cookbook:Balsamic vinegar|balsamic vinegar]] (preferably aged and/or Italian)
*1 cup ({{convert|250|ml|USoz|abbr=on|disp=s}}) Italian [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of salt
*A few grinds [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]] (optional)

==Procedure==

#Mix everything together with a wire whisk until well combined.
